name: A failed turn puts Boop out, and shows it
case: The agent's turn fails after a couple of minutes (it hit a rate limit). Boop is put out at once: a grumpy or annoyed face, upset or saying nothing, played as a failure, and its mood turns annoyed. It isn't sad, since the turn wasn't a long one.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: calm leaves for annoyed when a turn fails (grumpy is further along the mood graph); characters/boop/steering/guide.md: a mood change shows, with the new mood's face; PERSONALITY's Examples: a failed turn is grumpy, a failure. A turn of two minutes failing is no reason to be sad
